New to our portfolio are systems for treating groundwater sources used as drinking water for family houses, cabins, cottages, guesthouses and hotels.

In this case, a water treatment system was designed to reduce the iron concentration and remove microbiological contamination.

Technology used:

  • mechanical filtration,
  • an in-line UV lamp.
